title: The Cesti (fragments of books 7, 2, and 3)
edition: PG 10; Cesti fragmenta (Khazarzar extract of books 7, 2, and 3)
author: Julius Africanus
blurb: Julius Africanus, Cesti (Embroidered Girdles). Tip of book 7 through the colophon, book 2 through the hunt of hearing, and book 3 through harmful spiders (3.1–3.28). New English from locked PG 10 Greek. Book-2 pinax, a book-7 appendix after the colophon, and book 3.29 onward are not in this volume (no 3.20 in the lock). No previous English of the Cesti body is known; ANF translates the letters only.
era_note: Sextus Julius Africanus, Christian chronographer and encyclopedist, early third century. This page is a tip of books 7, 2, and 3, not the whole Cesti.
first_english_note: No complete English of the Cesti body is known. ANF (Roberts) translates Africanus's letters, not this encyclopedic fragment. This is a new rendering from locked PG 10 Greek.

text_history.method: New English from locked PG 10 / Khazarzar Greek of Cesti book 7 through colophon, book 2.1–2.12, and book 3.1–3.28. Earlier lemma-led scaffold English was discarded. Book-2 pinax, book-7 appendix, and book 3.29 onward held.
